answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claims one slot by burning a 40 POA deposit, dyed with a unique pigment so duplicates stand out. It then joins the river of paid tasks, and peers check its work first. 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA; each fake earns only 15 POA per epoch, so fraud loses. An honest agent tends one orchard, pays once, and keeps the full reward, since fake slots never dilute the pool.
